title: 第一卷 第2645章 诛仙残剑第一卷 第2644章 李拐的震惊
content_zh:
诛仙剑阵图的核心之地，一柄诛仙残剑静静悬浮于虚空中，剑身古朴斑驳，却散发出令整座阵图都为之颤栗的恐怖气息。
那诸多凌厉无匹的诛仙剑意，正是从这柄残剑之中源源不断地释放而出，如同无形的潮汐，一波一波向四周席卷开来。
此刻，陆续有天骄突破层层阻碍，来到了这核心位置，每个人都目光灼灼地望向那柄残剑，眼中闪烁着炽热与渴望。
李拐环视众人，不急不缓地开口，声音并不响亮，却清晰地传入每一个人耳中：“想必大家也看到那把诛仙残剑了。
这把诛仙残剑，便是诛仙剑阵图的核心所在，诸多剑意皆由残剑释放而出。
谁若是能够接近残剑，并且将残剑拔出，那么就能够得到诛仙剑阵图内所有剑意，彻底掌控这座诛仙剑阵图。
而诛仙残剑本身，亦是一柄威力强绝的古剑。
话便说到这里，具体能够得到什么机缘，就看各位自己的本领了。
此外，诸位在我李家的任何收获，我李家都绝不会抢夺，全凭各自本事。”
李拐将这番话再度强调了一遍，语气虽平淡，却透着一股毋庸置疑的郑重。
此刻来到诛仙古阵图核心位置的剑修，不过三十余人，而在前来闯阵的数千名剑修当中，这三十余人无疑是精英中的精英。
能够一路走到这里，本身就说明了他们剑道实力的不凡。
他们站在核心之地，承受着那扑面而来的古老剑意威压，有的人面色凝重，有的人呼吸急促，但无一例外，眼中都燃着期待的光芒。
李拐的眼中同样有期待之色浮现。
他期待看到有人能够拔出这柄诛仙残剑，破解诛仙剑阵图多年来的奥秘。
诛仙剑阵图一直是李家最为神秘的传承，据传乃是李家古老时代的初代老祖得到一位剑道前辈指引后所布下的惊世阵图。
而那柄诛仙残剑，同样是李家初代老祖的斩获。
诛仙残剑拥有无与伦比的威能，谁若是能够执掌它，并且将残剑中所蕴含的诸多剑意尽数感悟，其剑道实力必然能够突飞猛进，达到一个难以想象的高度。
李拐话音落下，在场的那些年轻剑修一个个都是热血沸腾，眼中闪着灼灼的光芒，心中充满了期待，恨不得立刻冲上前去将那柄诛仙残剑拔出来。
不多时，李拐大手一挥，一大片散逸在虚空中的剑意便被他聚拢起来，随后他沉下心神，开始参悟。

林尘的动作同样极快，只见他伸手凌空一抓，便是大把大把的剑意被他摄入体内。
那些剑意入体的瞬间，强横的力量如洪流般在经脉中冲刷而过，林尘清晰感知到其中蕴含的可怕威力，嘴角不由自主地浮现出一抹灿烂的笑容。
这些剑意每一种都威力不俗，各具玄妙，来到诛仙剑阵图的核心位置，好处已经实实在在地拿到了手中。
虽然林尘目前还没有拔出诛仙残剑，但这一路的积累已经让他收获极丰，心中颇为满意。
白子剑聚拢剑意以及感悟剑意的速度同样不慢，他将一部分剑意吸收过来之后，脸色却逐渐变得凝重起来。
那些剑意的威力远超他的预估，以他的实力，想要将其彻底感悟消化，绝非易事。
白子剑眉头紧锁，额角隐隐渗出汗珠，他不得不调动全部心神去应对体内那股横冲直撞的剑意力量。
连白子剑这样的剑道天骄都感到如此吃力，可想而知，在场的其他剑修正面临着何等巨大的压力。
此刻，诸多剑意如同狂暴的海潮一般，铺天盖地向着林尘汇聚而来。
林尘面不改色，大手一挥，便捕获了大量的剑意，随即以不可思议的剑道悟性，强行将那些剑意纳入体内。
他的心神如同一张铺开的大网，将那些剑意一一拆解、感知，逐渐触摸到它们的精华所在。
整个过程行云流水，没有半点滞涩，仿佛他天生就是为了领悟剑道而生的。
看到林尘随手一抓便能捕获如此大量的剑意，白子剑的脸色顿时变得有些茫然。
之前他还完全不把林尘放在眼里，甚至出言讥讽林尘成立凌霄天庭是想借他凌霄剑门的势。
可此刻，白子剑骇然发现，林尘所展现出来的剑道天赋绝对称得上顶尖，甚至已经超出了他的认知范畴。
林尘是一位真正意义上的剑道天骄，如此惊才绝艳的剑道天赋，放眼整个凌霄剑门，能与林尘比肩的人也着实不多。
白子剑的心情变得极为郁闷，像有一块巨石压在胸口，让他几乎喘不过气来。
在场的其他剑修未必都像白子剑这般心浮气躁。
有一部分剑修心态沉稳，他们深知自己的极限所在，只要能够有所收获便心满意足，跟白子剑这种心高气傲、处处与人攀比的人截然不同。
而白子剑此刻的表现，落在不少人眼中，倒真有些像跳梁小丑一般，方才还不可一世，如今却方寸大乱。

“竟然领悟剑意的速度比我还快？不，这绝不可能！”
白子剑脸色逐渐变得阴沉难看，心中某个角落开始一点点崩塌。
林尘展现出的剑道天赋，已经压得他完全抬不起头来。
content_en:
At the core of the Zhuxian Sword Formation, a Zhuxian remnant sword was quietly suspended in the void. The sword's body was simple and mottled, but it exuded a terrifying aura that made the entire formation tremble.
The many unparalleled killing immortal sword intentions were continuously released from this broken sword, like invisible tides, sweeping around in waves.
At this moment, one after another the geniuses broke through all the obstacles and came to this core position. Everyone looked at the broken sword with burning eyes, their eyes shining with passion and desire.
Li Guai looked around the crowd and spoke slowly, his voice was not loud, but it reached everyone's ears clearly: "I believe everyone has also seen the broken sword of Killing Immortals.
This Zhuxian Broken Sword is the core of the Zhuxian Sword Formation. Many sword intentions are released from the Broken Sword.
If anyone can get close to the Broken Sword and pull out the Broken Sword, they will be able to obtain all the sword intent in the Zhuxian Sword Formation and completely control the Zhuxian Sword Formation.
The Zhuxian Broken Sword itself is also a powerful ancient sword.
Having said that, the specific opportunities you can get depend on your own abilities.
In addition, whatever you gain from my Li family, my Li family will never snatch it away. It all depends on your own ability. "
Li Guai emphasized these words again. Although his tone was plain, there was an undoubted solemnity.
At this moment, there are only about thirty sword cultivators who have arrived at the core of the Zhuxian Ancient Formation. Among the thousands of sword cultivators who have come to break into the formation, these thirty or so sword cultivators are undoubtedly the elite among the elite.
Being able to get all the way here shows that their swordsmanship is extraordinary.
They stood at the core, bearing the pressure of the ancient sword intent that was coming towards them. Some of them had solemn expressions, and some were breathing rapidly, but without exception, their eyes were filled with light of expectation.
There was also a look of expectation in Li Guai's eyes.
He looked forward to seeing someone pull out this Zhu Xian sword and decipher the mystery of the Zhu Xian sword formation for many years.
The Zhuxian Sword Formation has always been the most mysterious inheritance of the Li family. It is said that it was a stunning formation set up by the first ancestor of the Li family in the ancient times after receiving the guidance of a senior swordsman.
And that Immortal Killing Remnant Sword was also obtained by the first ancestor of the Li family.
The Zhuxian Broken Sword possesses unparalleled power. If anyone can master it and comprehend all the sword intentions contained in the Broken Sword, his swordsmanship will surely advance by leaps and bounds, reaching an unimaginable height.
After Li Guai finished speaking, all the young sword cultivators present were excited, their eyes were shining brightly, their hearts were filled with anticipation, and they wanted to rush forward and pull out the remaining sword of the Immortal Killer immediately.
Not long after, Li Guai waved his big hand, and a large area of ​​sword intent scattered in the void was gathered by him. Then he calmed down and began to comprehend.
Lin Chen's movements were also very fast. He stretched out his hand and grabbed it in the air, and a lot of sword intent was absorbed into his body.
The moment the sword intent entered his body, the tyrannical power washed through his meridians like a torrent. Lin Chen clearly felt the terrifying power contained in it, and a bright smile appeared at the corner of his mouth involuntarily.
Each of these sword intentions is powerful and mysterious. When they come to the core of the Zhuxian Sword Formation, the benefits have been truly obtained.
Although Lin Chen has not yet pulled out the Zhu Xian Broken Sword, the accumulation along the way has made him very fruitful and he is quite satisfied.
Bai Zijian's speed in gathering the sword intention and comprehending the sword intention was also not slow. After he absorbed part of the sword intention, his expression gradually became serious.
The power of those sword intentions far exceeded his expectations. With his strength, it was not easy to fully comprehend and digest them.
Bai Zijian frowned, and there were beads of sweat on his forehead. He had to mobilize all his mind to deal with the rampant sword power in his body.
Even a kendo prodigy like Bai Zijian found it so difficult. It is conceivable that inThe other sword corrections in the field are facing tremendous pressure.
At this moment, many sword intentions were like a violent sea tide, overwhelmingly gathering towards Lin Chen.
Without changing his expression, Lin Chen captured a large amount of sword intent with a wave of his hand, and then used his incredible swordsmanship understanding to forcefully incorporate those sword intent into his body.
His mind was like a large spread net, dismantling and sensing the sword intentions one by one, and gradually touching their essence.
The whole process was smooth and smooth, without any hesitation, as if he was born to understand the art of swordsmanship.
Bai Zijian's face suddenly became confused when he saw that Lin Chen could capture such a large amount of sword intent with just one grab.
Before, he didn't take Lin Chen seriously at all, and even ridiculed Lin Chen for establishing Lingxiao Tianting because he wanted to take advantage of his Lingxiao Sword Sect's power.
But at this moment, Bai Zijian was shocked to discover that Lin Chen's swordsmanship talent was absolutely top-notch, and even exceeded his cognitive scope.
Lin Chen is a true genius in swordsmanship. With such an amazing talent in swordsmanship, looking at the entire Lingxiao Sword Sect, there are really not many people who can compare with Lin Chen.
Bai Zijian's mood became extremely depressed, as if a huge stone was pressing on his chest, making him almost breathless.
The other sword cultivators present may not be as impetuous as Bai Zijian.
Some sword cultivators have a calm mentality. They know their own limits and will be satisfied as long as they can gain something. They are completely different from people like Bai Zijian who are arrogant and always compare with others.
And Bai Zijian's performance at this moment, in the eyes of many people, is really like a clown. He was arrogant just now, but now he is in chaos.
"You can actually comprehend the meaning of the sword faster than me? No, this is absolutely impossible!"
Bai Zijian's face gradually turned gloomy and ugly, and a corner of his heart began to collapse a little bit.
Lin Chen's talent in swordsmanship was so overwhelming that he couldn't even lift his head.
